data.one_liner: A Flutter compass plugin providing a heading stream from 0 to 360 degrees.
data.what_it_does: Provides a compass heading stream ranging from 0 to 360 degrees where 0 represents north. It uses native sensors on Android and iOS to calculate orientation and heading. It also accounts for device orientation and handles sensor fallback mechanisms.
use_when: You need to build a compass feature in your app
You need real-time device heading updates via a stream
avoid_when: Targeting platforms where sensors are completely unavailable or unsupported (like standard web which returns an empty stream)
strengths: Accounts for device orientation matrix on both iOS and Android for stable readings
Provides accuracy and camera heading data through CompassEvent
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration and permissions on Android and iOS
Web platform support is minimal and always returns an empty stream
data.setup_notes: Requires adding location permissions and usage descriptions to AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist.

alternatives.name: sensors_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need broader device motion and orientation sensors like accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer instead of a pre-calculated compass heading.
